# c6-settings-data: settings and your data

Target: every preference, the privacy switches, the devices page, and exporting and importing data.
Risks: a preference that does not stick or does not apply, a language switch that leaves the app half translated, an
export or import that loses or corrupts data, a settings page that fails to load.
Start state: fresh user, desktop viewport, fake AI (select "Opus 5").
Out of bounds: account deletion, sign out.
